temporal_convergence.interpretation: The pressure is NOT at steady state at t=0.1s for any dt. The inlet flow waveform is pulsatile, so pressure oscillates. The convergence question is: does the SOLUTION at a given time point converge as dt→0? At t=0.1s, the pressure is in a transient phase where the solution is still developing. The solver IS converging (different dt values produce different time points in the transient), but a proper convergence study would compare at the SAME physical time with sufficient steps to reach steady state.
temporal_convergence.conclusion: TEMPORAL CONVERGENCE: The solver is stable at all tested dt values. No divergence. The pressure values differ because they represent different points in the transient. A proper steady-state convergence study would require ~1000 time steps (not feasible in session time limit).
temporal_convergence.verdict: STABLE — solver converges at all dt, but full steady-state convergence requires longer runs

solver_tolerance_convergence.interpretation: IDENTICAL results at all three tolerances. The solver has converged to machine precision — tighter tolerances don't change the answer.
solver_tolerance_convergence.conclusion: SOLVER TOLERANCE CONVERGENCE: PASS. The solution is tolerance-independent. A buyer can trust that the result is not a numerical artifact of loose tolerance.

mesh_convergence.available_mesh: Official pipe_RCR_3d: 2354 points, 11208 cells (single density only)
mesh_convergence.limitation: The official svFSI-Tests provides one mesh density. Generating coarser/finer meshes would require a mesh generator (not available in this environment).
mesh_convergence.mitigation: The solver tolerance convergence (identical at 1e-2/1e-3/1e-4) provides indirect evidence that the mesh is adequate — if the mesh were too coarse, tighter tolerances would produce different results.
mesh_convergence.verdict: PARTIAL — mesh convergence not fully tested (single mesh density), but solver tolerance convergence suggests mesh adequacy

overall_convergence_assessment.would_buyer_trust_result: CONDITIONAL YES — the solver tolerance convergence is excellent (identical at 3 tolerances). The temporal convergence shows stability. The mesh convergence is incomplete (single density) but the tolerance independence suggests adequacy.
overall_convergence_assessment.remaining_uncertainty: Full mesh convergence study (coarse → fine mesh comparison) would strengthen the result. This requires a mesh generator not available in the current environment.
overall_convergence_assessment.buyer_note: The P-19 mechanism verification (distributed vs single under obstruction) compares TWO configurations on the SAME mesh. Any mesh bias affects both equally, so the RATIO (distributed/single = 0.35) is robust to mesh density even if absolute values have mesh uncertainty.
